items.source: The exceptions returned by invoking getExceptionTypes on the Method passed to the invoke method are the exact set that can be thrown without resulting in an UndeclaredThrowableException being thrown.
items.translation: 调用传递给 `invoke` 方法的 `Method` 上的 getExceptionTypes 所返回的异常是在不导致抛出UndeclaredThrowableException的情况下可以抛出的确切集合。

items.source: UndeclaredThrowableException is used instead of java.lang.reflect.UndeclaredThrowableException.
